integrity: All assertions are supported by a finite-free combinatorial proof; computational checks are illustrative and do not certify infinite cases. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only factors whose periods are coprime to 3 are classified; nothing is claimed for periods divisible by 3, and the unrestricted critical exponent remains unresolved. Novelty comparison is bounded by inspected publications and accessible resources.
title: Sharp coprime-to-three period rigidity for cubes in the base-\(3/2\) digit-parity word
